lead: An `--ORACLE--` case cannot call `mb_*`: the `php` on the Windows `PATH` has no `mbstring`.
body: `Core\Str` counts grapheme clusters (`nvs_stdlib::granularity::DEFAULT` is `Unit::Grapheme`) where `substr` counts bytes and `mb_substr` code points, and the three coincide only inside ASCII with no carriage return. Put the ASCII agreement in one `--ORACLE--` file and the multibyte split in an `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` file with a frozen `--EXPECT--`.
